mapper.select: SELECT e.emotion_id AS emotionId, e.name, COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount FROM transactions t JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(t.occurred_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(t.occurred_at) = #{month} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' GROUP BY e.emotion_id, e.name ORDER BY count DESC, amount DESC
